summary.motive: Attack the vulnerable intermediate middle-of-the-field void (18-22 yards) against two-high and single-high defenses by pairing a deep post clearout with a crossing over-route.
summary.keyDefender: Weak Safety (FS in Quarters) & Mike Linebacker
summary.whyItWorks: The Duo run fake pulls the Mike linebacker into the line of scrimmage, while the Z vertical post forces both deep field safeties back, leaving X in single-coverage space on an over-route with a 20-yard running start.
summary.failureMode: Free safety sitting disciplined in the deep intermediate hole rather than biting on the run fake, or backside edge rusher beating the LT before the 7-step play-action drop develops.

beats.title: 1. The Heavy Duo Play-Action Suck
beats.text: The offensive line surges forward with physical Duo run blocking while the QB executes a deep under-center mesh. Both the Mike and Will linebackers violently trigger into the A/B gaps.

beats.title: 2. The Post Clearout & Crosser Stride
beats.text: Z explodes on a deep vertical post, forcing the strong safety and field corner 25 yards downfield. Meanwhile, X takes a clean inside release, building full acceleration into the deep intermediate void.

beats.title: 3. The High-Low Crosser Dilemma
beats.text: Tight end Y drags across at 4 yards depth, freezing the Will LB underneath. Behind the linebackers and underneath the retreating safeties, a massive 15-yard green canyon opens for X.

beats.title: 4. The Deep Over Cannon Strike
beats.text: The QB steps into a clean pocket and launches a 25-yard strike to X in full stride across the hashes, completely outflanking the defense for a 35-yard explosive touchdown.

relations.tell: Backside X receiver takes a deep inside release crossing behind second-level linebackers at 18-20 yards depth instead of digging or stalk blocking.
